result.brief: 针对 JEPA 潜世界模型编码器动作不敏感问题，提出逆动力学辅助损失修复潜表征，并验证语言目标规划与动作敏感性探针。
result.reason: Diagnoses JEPA latent world model encoder action-insensitivity and repairs it with inverse-dynamics auxiliary loss on encoder latents, improving planning; directly a representation-learning contribution for world models.
